editorial.blurb: Eat Fine Design by Khun Kung delivers authentic Thai cuisine with refined technique and bold, balanced flavors in an intimate, reservation-only setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Preorder your menu the day before your reservation to ensure the kitchen can pace your courses beautifully over 2 hours—the staff works hard and this approach transforms the experience.
signatureDishes: Duck red curry with lychee, grapes, and pineapple
